what: New code-review TSV columns are not routed through the existing fixed-index parser
scenario_or_breakage: Adding vN_tool columns after each uncertain cell shifts v2/v3 rating indexes, so fluff analysis silently reads tool labels as severities/qualities/correctness and corrupts later analysis
suggested_fix: Update parse_impl_tsv to read by header name while tolerating old 18-column logs, and add one fixture for the new code-review schema
